items.title: Josh Johnson: Set to get another start Sunday
items.text:
Coach Mike LaFleur has ruled out Carson Beck (back) for Sunday's game against the Commanders, which sets the stage for Johnson to start the contest, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carson Beck: Confirmed out Sunday
items.text:
Beck (back) will not play Sunday against the Commanders, coach Mike LaFleur said Friday, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Colston Loveland: Expected to land on IR
items.text:
The knee injury that Loveland sustained during Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions is expected to land him on IR, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
